name: Agent Linux
oneLiner: A source-built Linux desktop preview for agents on Apple silicon Macs
audience: Apple silicon Mac developers exploring supervised agent desktop workflows
problem: An agent and a person need a shared desktop with an explicit boundary for human control.
proofPoints: The README describes a source-built local developer preview, not public binaries or a hosted service (README.md).
The MCP command connects to existing machine state rather than starting the local VM (internal/cli/mcp.go).
The viewer supports an interactive human-input mode (internal/cli/view.go).

features.name: Source-built preview
features.description: Build the local developer preview for an Apple silicon Mac; the app is not notarized and no public VM image is published.

features.name: Existing-machine MCP
features.description: Connect an MCP client to existing local machine state; start the VM separately.

features.name: Human handoff
features.description: Use the interactive viewer to take control of the same guest desktop.

claims.text: Agent Linux is a source-built local developer preview for Apple silicon Macs; no public binaries or VM images are published and the app is not notarized.
The MCP command connects to an existing local machine; it does not start the local VM.
The interactive viewer supports human input on the shared guest desktop.
The README does not qualify real ARM64 guest agent runs or claim that hosted agents such as Devin run inside the VM; cloud and billing are development prototypes.
